requirement: This code should implement a home seeking function for an axis in a motion control system, handling various home seeking modes and managing motion commands based on the state of the system. The function block `SeekHome` should take inputs such as an axis reference (`_Axis` of type `AXIS_REF_SM3`), home command (`_xHome` as `BOOL`), abort command (`_xAbort` as `BOOL`), home mode (`_nHomeMode` as `HomeMode` enumeration), velocities (`_fFastHomeVel`, `_fSlowHomeVel` both as `LREAL`), acceleration (`_fHomeAcc` as `LREAL`), deceleration (`_fHomeDec` as `LREAL`), target home position (`_fHomePos` as `LREAL`), reference switch state (`_xReferenceSwitch` as `BOOL`), movement direction (`_nDirection` as `MC_DIRECTION`), and index pulse detection (`_xIndexPulse` as `BOOL`). Outputs include busy status (`_xBusy` as `BOOL`), done status (`_xDone` as `BOOL`), error status (`_xErr` as `BOOL`), and error ID (`_iErrId` as `DINT`). The function block should manage internal states and transitions based on inputs, executing different motion commands (`MC_MoveVelocity`, `MC_MoveAbsolute`, `MC_Halt`, `MC_SetPosition`) and handling errors and state transitions appropriately. Specific behaviors such as reacting to the reference switch, handling abort conditions, and setting final positions should be defined, ensuring robust error handling and state management.
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个运动控制系统中轴的寻找原点功能，处理各种寻找原点模式并根据系统状态管理运动命令。功能块 `SeekHome` 应接受输入，如轴引用（`_Axis` 类型为 `AXIS_REF_SM3`）、寻找原点命令（`_xHome` 为 `BOOL`）、中止命令（`_xAbort` 为 `BOOL`）、寻找原点模式（`_nHomeMode` 为 `HomeMode` 枚举）、速度（`_fFastHomeVel`、`_fSlowHomeVel` 均为 `LREAL`）、加速度（`_fHomeAcc` 为 `LREAL`）、减速度（`_fHomeDec` 为 `LREAL`）、目标原点位置（`_fHomePos` 为 `LREAL`）、参考开关状态（`_xReferenceSwitch` 为 `BOOL`）、移动方向（`_nDirection` 为 `MC_DIRECTION`）和索引脉冲检测（`_xIndexPulse` 为 `BOOL`）。输出包括忙碌状态（`_xBusy` 为 `BOOL`）、完成状态（`_xDone` 为 `BOOL`）、错误状态（`_xErr` 为 `BOOL`）和错误 ID（`_iErrId` 为 `DINT`）。功能块应管理内部状态和基于输入的转换，执行不同的运动命令（`MC_MoveVelocity`、`MC_MoveAbsolute`、`MC_Halt`、`MC_SetPosition`）并适当处理错误和状态转换。应定义特定行为，如对参考开关的反应、处理中止条件和设置最终位置，确保健壮的错误处理和状态管理。
